complete_examples.text: In order to analyze the system dynamics with consideration of the braking force, a new longitudinal wheel–rail interaction model is proposed in this paper.
With the heavy load of freight trains, more researchers have begun to study the longitudinal impulse and the longitudinal wheel–rail interaction of heavy-haul trains (Liu et al., 2016, 2017).
